sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM-o-2_6 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model is built in an end-to-end fashion based on SigLip-400M, Whisper-medium-300M, ChatTTS-200M, and Qwen2.5-7B with a total of 8B parameters. It exhibits a significant performance improvement over MiniCPM-V 2.6, and introduces new features for real-time speech conversation and multimodal live streaming.

sources.title: GitHub - IsiSinclair/MiniCPM-o-2.6: MiniCPM-o 2.6: A GPT-4o Level MLLM ...
sources.snippet: An enhanced feature of MiniCPM-o-2.6 is to act as an AI assistant, but only with limited choice of voices. In this mode, MiniCPM-o-2.6 is less human-like and more like a voice assistant.

sources.snippet: The most notable models in the series currently include: MiniCPM-V 4.6: 🔥🔥🔥 The latest and most efficient model in the MiniCPM-V series. With a total of 1.3B parameters, it surpasses larger models like Gemma4-E2B-it in performance, while showing superior efficiency than smaller models like Qwen3.5-0.8B (achieving ~1.5x token throughput).

sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM-o-2_6-int4 — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-o 2.6 INT4: GPT-4o Level Multimodal Intelligence for Edge Devices MiniCPM-o 2.6 is an end-to-end Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) designed for vision, speech, and multimodal live streaming. This version is the INT4 quantized variant, optimised for significantly lower memory usage while maintaining high performance.
